notes.title: Butterfly-knife DLC update
notes.content:
- Butterfly-knife DLC support
- rendering update (shader rework)
- Unity engine version update (2022.3 -> 6.0)
- switched from 'mono' to 'IL2CPP'
- grenade has been temporary removed

notes.title: Patch 0.5.13
notes.content:
--- Bug fixes ---
> at level 10 and at the boss level: the hint to use a hook displayed a bind for movement
> fixed the behavior of Music Hub in the main menu
> fixed a bug where the player became very small
> improved suction to the doors
> the hook icon was not displayed
> throwing a knife into nowhere now works correctly
> fixed an issue where a hit goes through, but bouncing off an enemy doesn't work
> Bots don't go through walls anymore
> Bots no longer shoot through walls
> If you open the speedrans in the main menu of the game, and then click the "more details" button, and press "esc", the previous speedrans page will close, but the details about the speedrans will remain and to close them you need to click on the cross.
> redesigned the speedrunner timer interface: 
- added a version of the game.
- The counter now counts deaths for the entire race, not just for the current level.


--- New features ---
> Added useless input lag compensation setting

notes.title: Gameplay Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056651/c7f3d5799011d97f2a8b9072b68d982f7a74fcdd.png[/img]

[b]The patch fixes major bugs and brings small improvements to the gaming experience.[/b]

List of changes:
[olist]
[ * ] Boss:
- lasers became more complicated on the boss, removed the ability to stand on the rotator.
- the machine gun now has more spread and bullet speed.
[ * ] Minor changes to the levels.
[ * ] Steam Cloud support for Campaign files and Speedrun files (not sure, but it should work).
[ * ] Pause now does not pause the speedrun stopwatch.
[ * ] Drones now have blue flames, to be non-confusing with rockets.
[ * ] Pause no longer skips drones on the boss.
[ * ] Pausing no longer reduces the speed to zero.
[ * ] Music hub no longer affects speed.
[ * ] Restart in Elevator no longer works.
[ * ] Restarting during enemy attacks no longer works.
[ * ] Gameplay trouble: It was like you were flying into a door from above and the character was trying to climb on top of it and you got stuck.
[ * ] Replay can no longer be spammed - no more than 1 time in 0.5 seconds.
[ * ] You can now use Esc in the menu and in the game to exit different windows.
[ * ] Robot explosion sounds have become more diverse so that you don't get bored in combos.
[ * ] The track cover is now loaded for the current track.
[ * ] Fixed a bug where you hitting a selected target, you would end up being drawn to another target.
[ * ] You can no longer cancel the hook with pause to keep time dilation.
[ * ] There was a bug: if you die while being drawn to an enemy, you can't move the camera in the game.
[ * ] Fixed a bug where you stumble in a tackle for no reason.
[ * ] Now you can rebind "Jump" to the mouse wheel
[ * ] Removed the method of acceleration through epileptic shaking of the camera
[ * ] Added a death counter for the entire speedrun to the campaign and speedrun mode:
- in campaign mode, go to the top corner
- go to the main menu in the campaign screen
[ * ] The Speedrun window now shows deaths at the current level and the time since respawning.
[/olist]
